name: audio-assistant
title: Audio Assistant
description: Browse your Music Assistant library and control playback from one music workspace.
author: opkelde

commands.name: music
commands.title: Music
commands.subtitle: Audio Assistant
commands.description: Search music, select players, and manage playback and queues.

commands.name: play-pause
commands.title: Play / Pause
commands.subtitle: Audio Assistant
commands.description: Play or pause the active Music Assistant player.

commands.name: next-track
commands.title: Next Track
commands.subtitle: Audio Assistant
commands.description: Skip to the next track on the active Music Assistant player.

commands.name: previous-track
commands.title: Previous Track
commands.subtitle: Audio Assistant
commands.description: Return to the previous track on the active Music Assistant player.

commands.name: volume-up
commands.title: Volume Up
commands.subtitle: Audio Assistant
commands.description: Increase volume by 5% on the active Music Assistant player.

commands.name: volume-down
commands.title: Volume Down
commands.subtitle: Audio Assistant
commands.description: Decrease volume by 5% on the active Music Assistant player.

commands.name: toggle-mute
commands.title: Toggle Mute
commands.subtitle: Audio Assistant
commands.description: Toggle mute on the active Music Assistant player.

preferences.name: demoMode
preferences.title: Demo Mode
preferences.label: Use simulated players and music (no audio)
preferences.description: Use fictional players and tracks to preview the interface without contacting a server.

preferences.name: serverUrl
preferences.title: Music Assistant Server URL
preferences.description: Direct Music Assistant URL, including any reverse proxy base path.

preferences.name: accessToken
preferences.title: Access Token
preferences.description: Create a long-lived token in Music Assistant under Settings → Users → Tokens.
